rules: No generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Space Grotesk for headings.
Use tight letter spacing for large text to maintain a cinematic, premium feel.
Do not use uppercase for standard body text.
Use pure black (#000000) for the main background to get a true theater feel.
Use #9333EA (Purple 600) as primary accent for CTAs, active states, and progress bars.
FORBIDDEN COLOR: #7351B7. Do not use this exact hex.
FORBIDDEN COLOR: #1B93A4 (Teal green/blue). Do not use for dashboards or UI elements.
Always tint neutral greys towards a cool tone to complement the purple (Zinc is preferred over Gray/Neutral).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use subtle glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) on the sticky navigation and player overlays. CRITICAL: Never use pure transparent backgrounds if content scrolls underneath.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use deep purple glow shadows on hover for featured content, e.g., shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(147,51,234,0.3)].
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px border-white/10 on cards and dialogs for crisp edges in the dark UI.

components.navigation: Sticky top bar with Logo, navigation links (Live, Movies, Series, My List), and Profile switcher. Must use glassmorphism.
components.hero_carousel: Large cinematic hero banner at the top showing a featured item from the playlist. Must have a dark gradient overlay at the bottom (bg-gradient-to-t from-black via-black/50 to-transparent) to blend into the rows without washing out the image.
components.content_rows: Horizontal scrollable rails. Posters should scale up on hover (scale-105) with a smooth transition. Use Aspect ratio 2:3 for Movies/Series and 16:9 for Live TV/Episodes.
components.player: Custom HTML5 player overlay or dedicated full-screen route. Custom controls overlapping video: Play/Pause, Volume, Timeline/Progress, Next Episode, Subtitles, PIP, Speed, Alternate Audio.
components.profiles: Full-screen profile selector on app launch, similar to Netflix 'Who's watching?'. Support avatars/emojis and optional PIN.
components.forms: Use a dark, immersive Bento grid style for the M3U/XStream configuration and playlist import forms.

layouts.app: Mobile-first, responsive grids. Main catalog uses full width with padded edges (px-4 md:px-8 lg:px-12).
layouts.catalog: Grid layouts must be strictly aligned. Horizontal scrolling rows (flex overflow-x-auto or carousels) should hide default scrollbars (scrollbar-hide).
layouts.player_overlay: Absolute positioned, full-viewport z-50 overlay when watching content.

motion.transitions: Use Framer Motion. Smooth fades between routes and subtle stagger animations for catalog rows.
motion.hover_states: Hovering over a movie card smoothly scales it up (duration-300 ease-out) and reveals quick actions.
motion.player_controls: Player controls fade out after 3 seconds of inactivity and fade in on mouse move.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over images uses text-shadow or gradient underlays for APCA/WCAG AA compliance.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500 focus:outline-none on all interactive elements. Do not remove focus outlines completely.
accessibility.aria: Include ARIA labels on all player controls (e.g., 'Play Video', 'Toggle Fullscreen').

media.video_player: Use HTML5 <video> combined with 'hls.js' for robust M3U8/HLS playback support. Ensure video element has playsInline and seamless UI overlays.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React (.js/.jsx files ONLY - do not use TypeScript/tsx).

Use IndexedDB (e.g., via 'idb' or 'localforage' libraries) for storing all state: profiles, loaded playlists, parsed catalog, 'Continue Watching' progress, 'My List', and playback state. This is a hard requirement for later migration to Cloudflare D1.
Implement the UI with a strict Netflix/Disney+ layout: A large Hero section at the top, followed by horizontal scrolling rails for Live, Movies, Series, and Continue Watching.
The app has NO demo fallback content. If the IndexedDB is empty, show a premium 'Welcome' or 'Profiles' screen to configure a profile and import an M3U/M3U8/XStream list.
For the video player, implement a fully custom HTML5 UI layered over the <video> element. Use 'hls.js' to parse and play M3U8 streams directly in the browser.
Support parsing of broad playlist formats (M3U/M3U8 file upload, URL, XStream config) and categorizing them into Live TV, Movies, and Series/Episodes.
Ensure all components from shadcn/ui are properly integrated in JavaScript.
Use standard emojis or the provided image URLs as default avatars for the 4 profiles.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Follow the design system strictly with left-aligned sections and varied grids.
CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing (e.g., data-testid='profile-select-button').
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism (backdrop-blur-xl).
Never apply universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties (e.g., transition-transform, transition-opacity) to avoid breaking rendering.
Do not center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is strictly banned).
Use modern pill-shaped or rounded-md buttons with clear interaction animations and the defined purple primary color.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js or similar standard path.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖, 🧠, etc.) for UI icons. Use lucide-react.
